definitions.gloss: loose-lipped, indiscreet, unable to keep secrets
definitions.explanation: Describes someone who easily reveals secrets or private information to others.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{口|くち}が{軽|かる}い⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{気|き}をつけて→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧。
{口|くち}が{軽|かる}い⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: You can't discuss important matters with someone who can't keep secrets.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{酒|さけ}→お酒：01045_osake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{口|くち}が{軽|かる}く⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I become loose-lipped when I drink.

examples.japanese: {口|くち}が{軽|かる}い⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}われる→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}して→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧⟦くれなく→くれる：00724_kureru⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If people think you're loose-lipped, no one will confide in you anymore.

examples.japanese: ⟦{秘密|ひみつ}→秘密：02504_himitsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦のに→のに：10529_noni⟧、⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{軽|かる}い→軽い：00785_karui⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{話|はな}して→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦しまった→しまう：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: Even though I said it was a secret, my loose-lipped friend told everyone.

notes:
STRUCTURE: ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧ (mouth) + ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ + ⟦{軽|かる}い→軽い：00785_karui⟧ (light). Literally 'one's mouth is light' - implying words come out easily.

ANTONYM: ⟦{口|くち}が{堅|かた}い→口が堅い：06885_kuchigakatai⟧ (tight-lipped, discreet)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{口|くち}が{滑|すべ}る→口が滑る：30585_kuchigasuberu⟧ (to let something slip, say something by mistake)
- ⟦おしゃべり→お喋り：01911_oshaberi⟧ (talkative, chatterbox)
- ⟦{口|くち}が{悪|わる}い→口が悪い：30586_kuchigawarui⟧ (to speak harshly, sharp-tongued) - different meaning

CULTURAL NOTE: In Japanese culture, keeping confidences is highly valued. Being called {口|くち}が{軽|かる}い is quite negative.
